title: Project Manager
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
 Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
   

  

**Your day at NTT DATA**
 The Senior Manager, Managed Services Operations is a senior management role, responsible for operating within a Region/Country or Services function and is accountable for service delivery at the highest level thereby ensuring client satisfaction and the successful continuance of business operations within the organization.
   

  

 The primary objective of this role is to ensure contracted Managed Services outcomes are delivered to the client and assists with the planning, building and supporting of delivering managed services to meet business objectives.
   

  

**Key responsibilities:**
* Proactively monitors and drives service delivery to clients.
* Manages client incidents by investigating and providing solutions that help solve client problems as escalated by team leaders and engineers.
* Works with client delivery teams to evaluate regional client reviews to ensure proactive incident management at client sites.
* Ensures that the standard client information repository related to technology, operations manuals is current and accurate.
* Creates and maintains a comprehensive list of client requirements, the scope of deliverables, technology and the delivery model.
* Runs the managed services operations in alignment with the service management service operations (SMSO) process, delivering promised outcomes to clients.
* Provides operational support and continuous service improvement post client handover from Technical Services (or other) teams.
* Plans and implements training and development initiatives for direct reports.
* Engages with clients for technical operations as part of routine operations.
* Plans and implements key service improvement priorities based on a continual service improvement approach.
* Feeds continual service improvement priorities into the automation team.
* Leads the team in the implementation of strategic initiatives and measures, analyses and improves team’s delivery capabilities.
* Ensures that tracking and monitoring of the performance of service delivery through all channels (human, digital, self\-service, automated) is carried out, metrics and reports are analyzed, and issues are resolved.
* Responsible for the day to day running of the Managed Services Operations team in line with the performance established by the business.
* Ensures maximum uptime and the accurate and early response to client operational issues.
* Responsible for resource planning and work allocation to meet agreed service levels.
* Identifies opportunities for continuous service improvement.
* Engages with clients for technical operations as part of routine operations


**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**
* Excellent organizational and team management skills.
* Excellent communication skills – both verbal and written coupled with excellent ability to collaborate with internal stakeholders and external clients.
* Extended understanding of budgets and cost management.
* Excellent time management, prioritization and delegation abilities.
* Excellent focus on client centricity.
* Highly focused on business outcomes.
* Ability to guide the team through transformational objectives set out by the business.
* Excellent ability to work across different cultures and social groups.
* Ability to work well in a pressurized environment and adapt to changing circumstances.


**Academic qualifications and certifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent degree in Information Technology or Computing or related field.
* ITIL certification is desirable.


**Required experience:**
* Extended experience in coaching and mentoring engineering team(s) gained within an information technology services organization.
* Extended demonstrated experience implementing continual service improvement initiatives (through automation, process enhancements).
* Extended demonstrated experience in organizational change management (transformational experience).
* Extended demonstrated experience in domain towers such as Network, Collaboration/Customer experience, Cloud, Security, Data Center.


**Workplace type:**
 On\-site Working
   

  

**About NTT DATA**
 NTT DATA is a $30\+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune
   

  

 Global 100\. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through
   

  

 responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with
   

  

 unmatched capabilities in enterprise\-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and
   

  

 application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move
   

  

 confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more
   

  

 than 70 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as
   

  

 established and start\-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each
   

  

 year in R\&D.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.
   

  

**Third parties fraudulently posing as NTT DATA recruiters**
 NTT DATA recruiters will never ask job seekers or candidates for payment or banking information during the recruitment process, for any reason. Please remain vigilant of third parties who may attempt to impersonate NTT DATA recruiters whether in writing or by phone in order to deceptively obtain personal data or money from you. title: Principal, Program Manager
description:
**Your role:**
 Ingram Micro is seeking experienced Principal, Program Manager – Agile Delivery who can lead Program delivery with a lean\-agile mindset. They must be quick learners and love challenging themselves to constantly raise the bar. This opportunity requires strong problem\-solving skills, an aptitude for team leadership and effective communication and collaboration across stakeholders as they deliver efficient, well\-designed, and sophisticated software systems for positive user experience.
   

  

 The Agile program management role will be establishing and executing all aspects of the program management function for the large\-scale, complex global digital program. This includes a portfolio of medium\- to large\-sized projects that are delivered across the Ingram global landscape.
   

  

 This position will effectively lead the program and engineering teams to deliver solutions that involve a combination of the following attributes: large\-scale program investments, multiple project teams, multiple technology disciplines, global or multiple region geographic deliveries, geographically disbursed delivery teams, and/or the highest\-level technical complexity. The program management function includes, but is not limited to: Program Leadership, Planning \& Administration, and Execution Integration.
   

  

 This position must have a mastery and proven prior experience working on a variety of digital programs/projects to succeed within the high\-paced environment of Ingram Micro’s Global Digital team. It is expected that the result of this position will be the delivery of an efficient and effective solution or series of solutions resulting in a competitive advantage for the company. A program is defined as a solution delivery team that is made up of multiple project teams all focused on delivering a single solution whose scope is large.
   

  

**What you bring to the role:**
* A Bachelor's degree is required, preferred in Computer Science/Engineering is required.
* Minimum of 8 years of demonstrated experience in combined program and project management delivery.
* Hands\-on experience implementing enterprise\-level software applications in a fast\-paced environment with an ability to manage multiple functional areas simultaneously
* Experience leading large cross\-functional teams and driving consensus among colleagues; the ability to lead, motivate, influence, and drive results in a highly matrixed environment is essential.
* Demonstrated strong leadership and have led program team members.
* Relationship management experience within an enterprise globally, among executives, customers, and staff; as well as externally with vendors and business partners as required.
* Experience in evaluating a broad range of internal and external factors when solving problems and making decisions; prioritizes team efforts to support critical, business growth\-driven initiatives
* Complex problem resolution and ability to merge diverse technology agendas into a cohesive, integrated digital and eCommerce solution by influencing key technology resources.
* Ability to conduct and interpret qualitative and quantitative analysis and problem\-solving skills and show independent judgment and creative problem\-solving techniques in a highly complex environment.
* Establish relevant and comprehensive program performance\-related metrics that highlight, not only the overall health of the project
* Collaborate with internal and external teams to maintain alignment toward program milestones.
* Drive process improvement to increase team efficiency. Curate internal training content and process documentation to keep teams aligned on standard operating procedures, guardrails, and best practices.
* Handling aspects of technical projects for their organization, responsible for initiating programs, following their progress, and serving as support providers in case issues arise.
* Manage Portfolio and program with constant communication with stakeholders, escalate impediments, help manage risk, and drive relentless improvement.
* Track project performance across scope, schedule, budget, and benefits realization.
* Maintain the enterprise project portfolio dashboard and provide insights to leadership.
* Support portfolio planning, prioritization, and resource allocation.
* Prince2/PMP Certification required
* Agile certification and understanding of SAFe methodologies required
* Superior communication skills, both written and oral.


**Specialized Knowledge \& Skills:**
* 5\+ years of experience with eCommerce/distribution domain
* Experience with Engineering and Implementing enterprise level software applications
* Experience with Agile Management Tools (i.e., Confluence, JIRA, VersionOne)
* Experience with leading global cross\-functional program teams
* Good skills and knowledge of servant leadership, facilitation, situational awareness, conflict resolution, continual improvement, empowerment, and increasing transparency.
* Knowledge of other Agile approaches: XP, Kanban, Crystal, FDD, etc.
* Awareness and experience with widely successful Agile techniques: User Stories, ATDD, TDD, Continuous Integration, Continuous Testing, Pairing, Automated Testing, Agile Games.
* Understand incremental delivery and the value of metrics
* Familiarity with common Agile practices, service\-oriented environments, and better development practices
* Understand backlog tracking, burndown metrics, velocity, and task definition
* Program Management: SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle), resource planning, MS Projects
* Proficient with MS Office Applications \- Word, Excel, Powerpoint, Visio, Adobe Applications, Project Management tools
* Knowledge of commonly used databases such as Microsoft SQL, Oracle, and Big Query

title: Program Coordinator - WV India
description:
With 75 years of experience, our focus is on helping the most vulnerable children overcome poverty and experience fullness of life. We help children of all backgrounds, even in the most dangerous places, inspired by our Christian faith.

**Employee Contract Type**

**Job Description**
**Job Title:**
 Program Coordinator
   

  

**Purpose Of The Job**
 A Program Coordinator (PC) works with a team of Community Mobilizers in the communities to enable mutual transformation – in the lives of children, families, supporters and WV staff themselves. The role serves as the primary link between the WV India Area Development Program office and the community mobilisers focusing on working with local groups and organisations to contribute towards child well\-being priorities in the area.
   

  

 A Programme coordinator acts as a facilitator and helps the community mobiliser’s teams to build on their existing strengths and facilitate links to technical support. They will be also responsible for a cluster to implement programmes and sponsorship in addition to providing coaching and mentoring.
   

  

**Key Deliverables**
* Ensure the effective communication of WV India identity, mission, vision, core values and approach to development including child sponsorship.
* Facilitate in enhancing the capacity of the community on ownership of child well\-being.

* Facilitate the development of locally contextual child selection criteria, and support the child selection process within in the primary focus areas.

* Facilitate community based monitoring of programmes \& monitoring support to the community mobilisers s within the
* Monitor the end user issues within the PFA.
* Enhance influence at the Block level.
* Promote a culture of excellence, team work and learning among the other community mobilisers s in the ADP.


**Priorities**
* Community Mobilization, Capacity Building \& action
* Partnering and planning with communities
* Sponsorship facilitation with communities
* Implementation and monitoring with communities and partners
* Capacity building of community mobilizers

* Data collection methodology.
* Having leadership skills to handle a team of 5 \- 7 persons.

title: Application Consultant-IBM Cloud Migration
description:
**Introduction**
 A career in IBM Consulting is built on long\-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long\-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
   

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 As an Application Consultant for Cloud Migration, you will play a key client\-facing leadership role in developing and delivering cloud migration solutions. You will lead the development of migration platform solutions for hybrid\-cloud environments, including IBM Cloud Private and IBM Cloud Platform, based on client priorities and business benefits.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**
* Lead Migration Solution Development: Lead the development of migration solutions for hybrid cloud platforms, including on\-prem, off\-prem, and dedicated cloud environments, in collaboration with client representatives.
* Build Migration Strategy: Lead the team in building migration strategies based on value vs. effort, and prepare cost\-benefit models and inputs to ROI analysis.
* Collaborate with Vendors/Partners: Lead discussions with migration vendors/partners to determine solution\-based tools/vendors specialties, including what vendor/tool, when, why, and benefits.
* Contribute to Migration Methodology: Significantly contribute to migration methodology and tailor methods to client environments and industries.
* Deliver Solution Design: Lead the team in delivering migration solution designs, including effort estimation, costing, staffing, client negotiations, and tailoring solutions to meet client budgetary guidelines.


**Preferred Education**
 Master's Degree
   

  

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
* Cloud Migration Solution Development: Exposure to leading the development of migration platform solutions for hybrid\-cloud environments, including IBM Cloud Private and IBM Cloud Platform.
* Hybrid Cloud Migration: Experience working with migration solutions for hybrid cloud platforms, including on\-prem, off\-prem, and dedicated cloud environments.
* Migration Strategy Development: Exposure to building migration strategies based on value vs. effort, and preparing cost\-benefit models and inputs to ROI analysis.
* Vendor/Partner Collaboration: Experience working with migration vendors/partners to determine solution\-based tools/vendors specialties.
* Migration Methodology: Exposure to contributing to migration methodology and tailoring methods to client environments and industries.


**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
* Cloud Migration Methodology: Exposure to contributing to migration methodology and tailoring methods to client environments and industries, with the ability to adapt to changing client needs.
* Hybrid Cloud Platforms: Experience working with migration solutions for hybrid cloud platforms, including on\-prem, off\-prem, and dedicated cloud environments, with a focus on delivering client\-centric solutions.
* Migration Solution Design: Exposure to delivering migration solution designs, including effort estimation, costing, staffing, client negotiations, and tailoring solutions to meet client budgetary guidelines.

title: Network Loss Manager RoW, ROW Central Functions
description:

 Are you looking for the opportunity to create substantial impact on business profitability through reduction of business wastes in operations, then Network Losses reduction role is that opportunity.  At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer\-centric company on earth and are constantly looking for ways to improve. Our team drives innovation while supporting continuous operational improvement. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. To be successful, you will need excellent communication, negotiation and influencing skills to drive consensus across multiple stakeholders. We interface with all miles of Operations, CS, Products team and CBW business teams to identify and execute solutions that improve Customer experience by reducing waste and losses in operations.
   

  

 This opportunity requires excellent troubleshooting, problem solving, and the ability to succeed in a fast\-paced, ambiguous and technical environment. Ownership of work is extremely important, and candidates should have a proven record of driving operations, process fixes and strategic initiatives to completion. The ideal candidate is motivated, optimistic and agile; with strong time management skill
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Develop deep understanding, hands on experience of operational processes across supply chain.
* Deep diving and analyzing operational data to arrive root causes for losses \- invent or replicate solutions to those root causes, track impact.

* 3\+ years of employee and performance management experience

* 1\+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience

title: Product Security Manager
description:
Driven by transformative digital technologies and trends, we are RIB and we’ve made it our purpose to propel the industry forward and make engineering and construction more efficient and sustainable. Built on deep industry expertise and best practice, and with our people at the heart of everything we do, we deliver the world's leading end\-to\-end lifecycle solutions that empower our industry to build better.
   

  

 With a steadfast commitment to innovation and a keen eye on the future, RIB comprises over 2,500 talented individuals who extend our software’s reach to over 100 countries worldwide. We are experienced experts and professionals from different cultures and backgrounds and we collaborate closely to provide transformative software products, innovative thinking and professional services to our global market. Our strong teams across the globe enable sustainable product investment and enhancements, to keep our clients at the cutting\-edge of engineering, infrastructure and construction technology.
   

  

 We know our people are our success – join us to be part of a global force that uses innovation to enhance the way the world builds.
   

  

 Find out more at RIB Careers.
   

  

**Job Title:** 
 Product Security Manager
   

  

**Location:** 
 India
   

  

**Job Type:** 
 Full\-time
   

  

 Driven by transformative digital technologies and trends, here at RIB we’ve made it our primary purpose to propel the industry forward and make engineering and construction more efficient and sustainable.
   

  

 Managing the entire building lifecycle from planning to construction, the development of our powerful portfolio of software solutions is driven by industry expertise, best practice and a passion to remain at the cutting edge of technology. Ultimately, connecting people, processes and data in innovative ways to ensure customers always complete projects within budget, on time and to quality, while reducing their carbon footprint.
   

  

 RIB Software is a proud member of Schneider Electric.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 As a
 **Product Security Manager** 
 you will own operational security for assigned RIB Software products, executing
 **secure development lifecycle** 
 (SDL) requirements and ensuring compliance through coordinated
 **security reviews and assessments** 
 . Serves as the primary security point of contact for product teams while collecting evidence required for compliance.
   

  

 This role requires a blend of hands\-on technical expertise, security leadership, and the ability to work collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams including Security Architects, Product Owners, Developers, Quality Engineers, DevOps, Security Operations, and Governance. You will be a key driver in our mission to embed security into every stage of our products’ lifecycles, from initial design through to decommissioning and end\-of\-life.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Execute SDL requirements across the full product development lifecycle.
* Drive regular threat modelling, security reviews, and risk assessments for assigned products.
* Track and manage product\-specific security issues through resolution, communicating status to leadership.
* Manage supply chain security risks for externally provided components used within the product.
* Collect and maintain compliance evidence for compliance requirements.
* Coordinate security activities with development teams through Security Architects and Product Owners in collaboration with our Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing team.
* Identify and refine security requirements applicable to the product across its lifecycle.
* Serve as primary contact for customer security discussions, assessments, and vulnerability disclosure.
* Support security training and assessment initiatives to ensure product teams have demonstrated security expertise.
* Mentor assigned Product Security Engineers through collaborative review and guidance (when PSE support is available).
* Contribute to the security architecture and roadmap by advising on evolving threats and new technologies.


**Qualifications And Experience**
* 5\+ years experience in product security or application security.
* Strong understanding of SDL processes and security compliance frameworks.
* Proven ability to conduct security testing using SAST, DAST, and SCA tools.
* Familiarity with one or more of C\#, Typescript, Java, JavaScript, Dart, C\+\+, Python, and/or Delphi
* Experience with vulnerability management and risk assessment.
* Excellent communication skills for technical and business stakeholders.
* Project management experience with cross\-functional teams.
* Ability to drive improvements in security culture.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently and provide guidance to technical colleagues.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or related field, or equivalent professional experience.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* CSSLP or similar secure development certification
* Familiarity with cloud security best practices (preferably Azure)
* Experience with enterprise software security frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001\)
* Experience with product or cloud security architecture
* Background in SaaS or enterprise software environments


**Reports To:** 
 Product Security Lead
   

  

 We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, as well as opportunities for professional growth and development. If you are a motivated self\-starter with a passion for application security, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.
   

  

 RIB may require all successful applicants to undergo and pass a comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.
   

  

 RIB is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business.
   

  

 Come and join RIB to create the transformative technology that enables our customers to build a better world.

 Experience and Qualifications

title: Delivery Manager
description:
**Overview**
 We are looking for a Technical Delivery Manager to lead our Digital Process Automation (DPA) initiatives. This role requires close collaboration with the Product Management, Policy Operations, and Content Operations teams to drive innovative automation solutions that enhance operational efficiency, increase revenue, and reduce manual effort. The ideal candidate will also ensure seamless integration of AI solutions into the business unit's (BU) product suite of applications.
   

  

 This role requires leveraging spec\-driven development (an AI\-native development approach) and influencing business stakeholders to align with this approach.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead and manage a team focused on developing automation solutions for manual\-intensive workflows.
* Collaborate with the Product Management and Business Operations teams to identify automation opportunities.
* Oversee the design, development, and deployment of automation solutions with an AI\-first strategy.
* Provide technical direction by leveraging a strong understanding of how AI technologies and generative AI can help solve business challenges, and guide the team in implementing AI\-driven automation.
* Ensure strong collaboration with application development teams to seamlessly integrate automation solutions into the BU's product suite of applications, ensuring scalability and minimal disruption.
* Drive stakeholder management, ensuring effective communication and alignment of automation goals.
* Apply critical thinking and problem\-solving skills to address complex business challenges.
* Utilize negotiation skills to balance business priorities, technical feasibility, and resource constraints.
* Stay updated on the latest AI, ML, and automation trends to drive innovation and efficiency.


**Qualifications**
* 12\+ years of overall IT experience, including at least 4 years delivering AI solutions.
* Proven experience in Business Process Automation/Digital Process Automation.
* Strong technical expertise in Python; LLM architecture (transformers, embeddings, context windows); prompt engineering; LangChain/LangGraph or equivalents (LlamaIndex, CrewAI); RAG and vector databases (Pinecone/Qdrant/Chroma/pgvector/OpenSearch); agent and tool\-calling frameworks, including MCP; evaluation frameworks (Ragas); LLMOps and tracing (Langfuse/Arize); and cloud AI services (Bedrock/Vertex/Azure OpenAI).
* Strong understanding of how AI technologies and generative AI can help solve business challenges, with the ability to provide strategic direction to the team.
* Experience in stakeholder management, working with cross\-functional teams, and aligning automation initiatives with business goals.
* Strong collaboration skills to ensure automation solutions are effectively integrated into the BU's product suite of applications.
* Strong problem\-solving, negotiation, and critical thinking abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and drive results in a fast\-paced environment.

title: Business Accountability Senior Manager- Technology Risk Delivery Management
description:
**About This Role**
 Wells Fargo is seeking a Business Accountability Senior Manager.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Manage and develop teams of specialists and managers to oversee moderate to highly complex activities associated with the development and implementation of business\-specific programs, processes, and controls which identify, assess, monitor, measure, and mitigate risk
* Identify and recommend opportunities for process improvement, risk mitigation, and control strategies
* Determine appropriate strategies and actions, interpret and develop policies and procedures, and provide leadership to strategize and execute a variety of programs, services, initiatives, protocols, and deliverables that are moderate to high\-risk within scope of responsibility
* Collaborate with and influence all levels of professionals including senior managers
* Engage and influence business heads, regulators, control management, risk, legal, and audit partners to successfully ensure appropriate management of business risk
* Develop and guide a culture of talent development to meet business objectives and strategy


**Required Qualifications:**
* 7\+ years of risk management, business controls, or compliance experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
* 3\+ years of management or leadership experience


**Desired Qualifications:**
**Delivery Intake \& Triage**
* Own the centralized delivery intake process for Technology delivery initiatives.
* Assess incoming demand for scope, priority, execution risk, stakeholder impact, and required level of support.
* Route work to the appropriate delivery owners and aligned DRM teams based on risk, execution needs, and program maturity.
* Maintain visibility of intake status, ownership, and next steps through a consistent tracking model.


**Portfolio Monitoring \& Execution Governance**
* Establish common portfolio monitoring routines across supported delivery workstreams.
* Track progress against milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, and remediation commitments.
* Use common cadence, thresholds, and governance practices to identify execution gaps early.
* Provide consistent leadership updates on delivery status, risk posture, and items requiring decisions or escalation.
* Coordinate execution across Technology teams, CIO partners, control partners, and delivery stakeholders.
* Align delivery activities to agreed priorities, timelines, ownership, and escalation paths.
* Reduce duplicate touchpoints and handoffs by creating clear engagement expectations and operating routines.
* Ensure work moves through the delivery lifecycle with clear accountability and timely decision\-making.


**Risk\-Based Escalation \& Issue Resolution**
* Identify at\-risk initiatives, execution blockers, ownership gaps, and missed impacts through proactive monitoring.
* Escalate delivery risks using agreed thresholds, leadership forums, and defined escalation pathways.
* Drive resolution of delivery blockers by coordinating accountable owners and decision\-makers.
* Support earlier gap detection and stronger remediation completion through consistent tracking and follow\-up.


**Reporting, Communications \& Stakeholder Engagement**
* Create standardized progress reporting, delivery dashboards, and risk\-based notifications for leadership and aligned teams.
* Communicate delivery status, dependencies, risks, and decisions in a concise and executive\-ready manner.
* Facilitate operating cadences, governance reviews, and stakeholder routines for the Delivery Management portfolio.
* Serve as the primary Delivery Management point of contact for intake, orchestration, monitoring, and escalation topics.


**Process Standardization \& Continuous Improvement**
* Standardize delivery playbooks, templates, engagement cadences, and escalation models.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual tracking, duplicate follow\-ups, rework, and inconsistent communications.
* Strengthening delivery management practices through automation, improved tooling, and data\-driven reporting where feasible.
* Promote a scalable approach that improves visibility, prioritization, accountability, and execution discipline.


**Job Expectations:**
* 7\+ years of strong experience in Delivery Management, Portfolio Management, Program Management, PMO, or Technology Transformation.
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex delivery portfolios with multiple stakeholders, dependencies, and execution risks.
* Strong governance, reporting, escalation, and executive communication skills.
* Ability to design and operate intake, prioritization, monitoring, and escalation frameworks.
* Comfort working with Technology, Risk, Compliance, and Business stakeholders in a matrixed environment.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and organizational skills, with ability to turn fragmented information into clear execution plans and leadership insights.
* People leadership experience with the ability to set direction, build capability, and drive accountability.
* Create a single, consistent Delivery Management operating model for intake, triage, progress tracking, risk identification, and escalation.
* Provide leadership visibility into delivery health, execution gaps, dependencies, and emerging risks.
* Coordinate execution across Technology stakeholders using standardized communications, reporting, and escalation pathways.
* Move the delivery management function from reactive follow\-up to proactive, risk\-based monitoring and orchestration.


**Posting End Date:**
 17 Sep 2026
   

  

* Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.


**We Value Equal Opportunity**
 Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.
   

  

 Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance\-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit's risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.
   

  

 Candidates applying to job openings posted in Canada: Applications for employment are encouraged from all qualified candidates, including women, persons with disabilities, aboriginal peoples and visible minorities. Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request in connection with the recruitment process.
   

  

**Applicants With Disabilities**
 To request a medical accommodation during the application or interview process, visit Disability Inclusion at Wells Fargo .
   

  

**Drug and Alcohol Policy**
 Wells Fargo maintains a drug free workplace. Please see our Drug and Alcohol Policy to learn more.
   

  

**Wells Fargo Recruitment And Hiring Requirements**
* Third\-Party recordings are prohibited unless authorized by Wells Fargo.
* Wells Fargo requires you to directly represent your own experiences during the recruiting and hiring process.

description:
**Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count?**
 Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. Across the globe, we’re 150,000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve. We stand for our values, building long\-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world.
   

  

 With a vision to be the world’s most trusted financial group, it’s part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career.
   

  

 Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.
   

  

**Job Profile**
 The Information Security Services Team is seeking an Information Security Product \& Service Delivery Specialist – Global Security Operations to drive the delivery and execution of cybersecurity services across the Global Security Operations Center (GSOC) Center of Excellence. This role is responsible for ensuring consistent, high\-quality delivery of core GSOC services—including log ingestion, use case development, threat detection, and incident response operations—across all regions. The specialist will lead cross\-functional coordination, manage operational performance metrics, and ensure service delivery aligns with enterprise risk objectives, governance standards, and evolving global requirements.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Drive end\-to\-end execution of GSOC service delivery across global regions, ensuring consistency in operations such as log ingestion, use case lifecycle management, threat detection, and incident response.
* Coordinate the onboarding and integration of new log sources, working with regional teams and technology partners to ensure timely ingestion and coverage alignment with risk priorities.
* Lead the development, tuning, and governance of GSOC use cases to improve detection accuracy, reduce false positives, and address emerging threat vectors.
* Manage cross\-functional programs from initiation through delivery, ensuring milestones are met and outcomes are communicated effectively to stakeholders across regions.
* Develop and manage key performance indicators (KPIs) and service\-level metrics that reflect operational health, risk appetite, and residual risk—enabling transparent reporting to senior leadership and governance bodies.
* Partners with cybersecurity, risk, and control teams to coordinate remediation efforts, track progress, and resolve operational gaps in service delivery.
* Facilitate process improvement initiatives and stakeholder engagement to identify inefficiencies and drive enhancements across GSOC workflows and service operations.
* Conduct end\-to\-end service delivery evaluations, prioritizing improvement opportunities based on impact, feasibility, and strategic alignment.
* Integrate industry frameworks, best practices, and regulatory requirements into GSOC operational workflows to ensure compliance and adaptability across jurisdictions.
* Monitor developments in cybersecurity programs, regulatory landscapes, and internal organizational changes that influence GSOC service execution and reporting.


**What You'll Bring**
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field; equivalent experience also considered.
* 10\-12 years of experience in cybersecurity operations, security service delivery, program management, or risk management, ideally within financial services.
* Hands\-on familiarity with GSOC functions such as log ingestion, SIEM operations, use case development, threat detection, and incident response workflows.
* Proven experience in strategic planning, program execution, and executive\-level reporting.
* Knowledge of models/frameworks such as Cyber Kill Chain and MITRE ATT\&CK
* Demonstrated creative problem\-solving abilities
* Experience creating trending, metrics, and management reports
* Skilled in developing briefing materials, managing logistics, and facilitating cross\-functional collaboration across global teams.
* Demonstrated ability to drive operational efficiency through technology and process innovation.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to tailor messaging for technical and non\-technical audiences.


**Preferred**
* Experience working in Japanese corporate environments or proficiency in Japanese.
* Experience managing global, cross\-cultural teams and coordinating service delivery across multiple regions.
* Broad exposure across cybersecurity domains (governance, risk, network security, threat/vulnerability management, incident response).
* Familiarity with automation, AI, or light scripting for reporting and operational efficiency.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, Security\+, ISSMP, SANS, GSEC, GCFA, GNFA, GIAC and/or GCIH)
* Knowledge in one or more security domains including Security Governance and Oversight, Security Risk Management, Network Security, Threat and Vulnerability Management, and Incident Response and Forensics
* Experience with cloud computing security, network, operating system, database, application, and mobile device security.
* Experience with information security risk management, including conducting information security audits, reviews, and risk assessments.


 Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG) is an equal opportunity employer. We view our employees as our key assets as they are fundamental to our long\-term growth and success. MUFG is committed to hiring based on merit and organsational fit, regardless of race, religion or gender.

title: Project Manager
description:
**Job Purpose**
 The Project Manager is responsible for managing customer projects from initiation through delivery, ensuring projects are completed on time, within budget, and to agreed quality standards. Acting as the primary point of contact for customers, this role coordinates internal teams, manages project finances, mitigates risks, and drives customer satisfaction while applying RWS tools, technologies, and best practices. The role is responsible for project planning, financial management, customer satisfaction, risk management, and collaboration with internal teams to achieve successful project outcomes.
   

  

**About Transform**
 At RWS, we enable the world’s largest enterprises to communicate with global audiences through cutting\-edge language technology, AI\-driven solutions, and expert services. Our RWS Transform division empowers organizations to accelerate digital transformation, scale global content, and unlock growth in every market.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Job Overview**
* Project Delivery \& Customer Management
+ Act as the primary point of contact for customers for all project\-related activities.
+ Manage multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring delivery on time, within budget, and to required quality standards.
+ Set up and manage end\-to\-end project workflows using RWS tools, technologies, and best practice methodologies.
+ Prepare accurate project quotes, schedules, and resource plans that align with customer requirements.
+ Clearly communicate project requirements to internal production teams to ensure successful execution.
+ Maintain strong customer relationships and consistently deliver a high level of customer satisfaction.
+ Support onboarding of new customers and guide them through RWS solutions, workflows, and processes.
+ Participate in customer meetings, provide project updates, and ensure follow\-up actions are completed on time.


**Financial \& Commercial Management**
* Ensure effective financial management across projects and programs.
* Monitor project budgets, profitability, and work\-in\-progress (WIP).
* Raise and manage purchase orders (POs) and sales orders (SOs).
* Ensure timely customer invoicing and support debt collection activities.
* Prepare accurate budget forecasts and financial submissions.
* Deliver projects in line with agreed margin and profitability targets.

* Proactively manage issues and escalate concerns when appropriate.
* Implement mitigation plans to ensure successful project delivery.

+ Budgets
+ Version control
+ Purchase orders
+ Invoicing records
+ Project archives

* Ensure compliance with ISO standards, quality processes, and internal governance requirements.
* Follow established project management methodologies and operational procedures.

* Contribute positively to a collaborative team environment.

* Support data accuracy for operational planning and decision\-making.
* Promote efficiency, quality, and continuous improvement across customer accounts and internal operations.

* Knowledge of customer industries, business objectives, organizational structures, and stakeholder management.

**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
**About QAD Redzone**
 Redzone helps manufacturers make more stuff for less while greatly improving the employee experience. While there is a lot of hype around digital transformation, the factory of the future, and Industry 4\.0, the focus has been on the equipment and technology – not the people. At Redzone, we are all about the people, what we call “the connected worker.” We make frontline teams more engaged and more productive so their lives improve while contributing to positive business outcomes. We do this by combining exceptional software and world class coaching, giving our customers an average productivity increase of 22% in 90 days. Redzone brings together Production, Maintenance and Quality teams, improving the communications between those teams to resolve issues and increase output. Decision making happens on the shop floor by the people doing the work, in real time, for immediate impact and a better overall employee experience.
   

  

 With over 1000 customers, 1200 plants and 325,000 users, Redzone is changing the way people work – one plant at a time.
   

  

 Founded in 2013 with a bold vision to transform manufacturing performance, while bringing dignity back to the frontline worker. Redzone provides the tools that enable the self\-organizing adaptive behavior of the front\-line manufacturing team to win the productivity game, avoiding downtime, or quality losses.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Under the leadership of Coaching Director, the Project Manager is responsible for management and oversight of Redzone’s project implementation.
   

  

 This position is Full Time, Remote and required to travel 40% of the time.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Facilitate and lead the customer journey for 6\-12 weeks after each new customer is added until we go onsite to coach.
* Participate in onsite Success Plan to focus the customer on the priority activities that need completion.
* Ensure signals are connected and tested prior to onsite coaching.
* Support the infrastructure and installation for Visual Factory.
* Guide the customer and provide support configuration to map Redzone to the customer’s site.
* Highlight any risks and address them with the customer team, Coaching Director, and Platform Leadership.
* Responsible for overseeing the deployment of Redzone software for multiple concurrent clients\- manage the process from the handover from the sales team through providing onsite coaching services.
* Configure and setup Redzone software that matches the production process at the client’s manufacturing plant. This process must include manufacturing data such as product and equipment information and product run rates.
* Ensure automation signals from the plant (such as photo eyes or machine cycles) come back to the software and provide accurate and real time data to Redzone for the shop floor team.
* Ensure the contractor work with the hardware and automation happens quickly and efficiently while maintaining the project schedule and cost plan.
* Perform regular weekly status calls with active project teams across multiple clients in order to ensure project stays on track and all milestones are achieved.
* Responsible for the success of the software and coaching a “Green Go Live” based on project management leading up to that point.
* Manage client relationships and satisfaction, including but not limited to serving as the point of contact for projects, responding to client requests, and critical events in a professional and timely manner.
* Understand the escalation process for any critical path items or risk points that could result in delays or unsatisfactory project result(s).
* Document and maintain the project templates, training decks, and communication tools that are used with clients.
* Support on\-site Continuous Improvement Coaches and customers with configuration, expansion, and automation requests.
* Other duties as assigned.


**Qualifications**
**Required Skills**
* Understand the shop floor environment, workflow, and processes in Food \& Beverage and Consumer Packaged Goods’ for a variety of industries with the necessary depth to foster confidence and to support the client during the project.
* Sound judgement and excellent assessment skills.
* Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills.
* Understand escalation process for any critical path items or risk points that could cause a delay or unsatisfactory project result.

 Under the general supervision of an LV Project Management Supervisor or Department Manager, to create error\-free linguistically validated Patient Reported Outcomes instruments through a reiterative process of harmonization, back translations, expert review, in\-country review and cognitive debriefing. Regularly serves as lead project manager and main client contact. Provides training to department members. Completes special projects as needed.
   

  

**About Transform**
 At RWS, we enable the world’s largest enterprises to communicate with global audiences through cutting\-edge language technology, AI\-driven solutions, and expert services. Our RWS Transform division empowers organizations to accelerate digital transformation, scale global content, and unlock growth in every market.
   

  

**About Linguistic Validation**
 Linguistic Validation (LV) is a specialized business unit within RWS Regulated Industries that focuses on the translation, validation, licensing, and electronic implementation of Clinical Outcome Assessments (COAs). COAs are questionnaires completed during clinical trials which allow sponsors to collect data about treatment effectiveness, side effects, and health status directly from patients and caregivers.
   

  

 The LV Team is over 20 years of experience in the COA field, positioning us as the industry leader. Our team performs a wide variety of functions in addition to translation, including recruitment and interviewing of patients around the world, development of novel research for presentation and publication, expertise in licensing and copyrights, and management of electronic implementation of COAs (eCOA) in over 80 languages.

description:
**About PRAGATI** 




 Rural India is central to India's economic future, accounting for 63% of the population and 70% of the workforce. Yet a large share of rural livelihoods remains concentrated in relatively low\-productivity agriculture, creating a significant opportunity to shift towards higher\-income economic activity.
 



 PRAGATI (Programme for Rural Advancement, Growth and Transformative Initiatives) is a TCF\-incubated organisation focused on accelerating economic prosperity in rural India. Its work is centred on two priorities:
 


* Increasing agricultural incomes by addressing structural constraints across land, inputs, finance, markets, processing and trade.
* Creating scalable non\-farm livelihoods by identifying, financing and supporting promising rural enterprises that can generate local jobs.



 PRAGATI works with central ministries and state governments to combine policy and economic analysis with hands\-on implementation. It identifies high\-potential opportunities, partners with relevant government institutions, tests solutions on the ground, and develops models that governments can ultimately own and replicate.
 



 PRAGATI is also leading Amrit Prayas, a 10\-year economic development initiative in the Deoria Lok Sabha constituency. It serves as a live testbed for coordinated interventions across agriculture, agro\-processing, labour\-intensive manufacturing and other growth sectors, with the aim of developing a replicable district transformation playbook.
 



  





**Role Summary** 




 PRAGATI is working with the Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD) to help shape the next phase of rural development — building on MoRD's strong welfare and infrastructure delivery platform to increasingly enable sustained income growth and rural prosperity. The engagement focuses on three pathways: increasing agricultural incomes, creating non\-farm local livelihood opportunities, and enabling skilling for remunerative migration.
 



 The Senior Program Manager – Rural Economic Transformation (MoRD) will lead this engagement on a day\-to\-day basis. The role combines strategy, policy and execution — identifying and structuring complex problems, conducting rigorous analysis, designing practical interventions, building alignment with government and ecosystem stakeholders, and driving initiatives through implementation. The SPM will lead a small team and work closely with senior MoRD officials, PRAGATI leadership, financial institutions, experts and private\-sector partners.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Work with MoRD and PRAGATI leadership to identify and prioritise high\-impact opportunities for increasing rural incomes.
* Structure complex problems into clear hypotheses, analytical workstreams and actionable interventions.
* Lead research and analysis across agriculture, rural enterprise, finance, skilling and migration.
* Translate priority opportunities into practical program and policy designs, including implementation models, financing mechanisms and outcome frameworks.
* Build the economic and operational case for new initiatives and government partnerships, working with experts and ecosystem partners to refine solutions.
* Translate ministry priorities into clear workplans, owners, milestones and deliverables, and establish a strong operating rhythm across workstreams.
* Identify and resolve bottlenecks, ensuring initiatives move from concept and approval to implementation.
* Build trusted relationships with senior MoRD officials and coordinate across ministries, state governments, public institutions, financial institutions and implementation partners.
* Prepare senior\-level engagements and translate discussions into clear decisions and follow\-up actions.
* Manage and mentor the MoRD PMU team, maintaining a high bar for rigour, ownership and execution.



  





**Qualifications and Skills** 



* 8–10 years of professional experience, ideally in management consulting, strategy, transformation, public policy, economic development or a similar problem\-solving environment.
* Demonstrated ability to own complex programs end\-to\-end, from problem definition and solution design through stakeholder alignment and implementation.
* Strong stakeholder\-management skills and the maturity to work with senior government officials, business leaders, financial institutions and experts.
* Strong quantitative skills and comfort working across policy, strategy and implementation.
* Entrepreneurial and comfortable working in an early\-stage organisation, with a strong interest in rural economic development and government\-led transformation.
* MBA or postgraduate degree from a leading institution is preferred, but not mandatory.

This role sits within our Programs function, driving data\-informed decision\-making that strengthens the impact and credibility of our work.
   

  

**THE ROLE**
 We are looking for an experienced Program Manager with 3–5 years of hands\-on experience in program documentation, data collection, and monitoring \& evaluation. Experience or understanding working on developing web\-based or app\-based program management monitoring systems is desirable. This role is central to how Sol’s ARC tracks, measures, and communicates its impact — managing documentation systems, designing data frameworks, and translating data into insights that drive strategic decisions. You will work closely with Program, M\&E, and Technology teams to ensure accurate, timely reporting aligned with organisational and donor requirements.
   

  

**Approximately**

**30% – M and E Systems, Documentation \& Reporting**
**30% – Data Analysis, Quality Checks \& Program Monitoring**
**20% – Data Collection and Management**
**20% – Cross\-functional Collaboration \& Capacity Building**
**What You’ll Actually Do**
**M and E systems, Documentation \& Reporting**
* Ensure all data collection systems and tools are aligned with program goals and reporting frameworks.
* Design M \& E forms and tools
* Develop dashboards, MIS reports and presentation for internal and external stakeholders
* Collaborate with technology teams to develop or integrate tools that support streamlined data collection, tool design and data management.

**Data Management**

**Cross\-functional Collaboration \& Capacity Building**
* Conducting cross\-team discussions to understand program implementation and data collection challenges
* Provide M and E data and platform related technical support.
* building program teams capacity to collect, manage, and use data effectively
* Participate in team meetings, sharing insights, providing recommendations, and keeping staff informed on documentation and data management practices.
* Represent Sol’s ARC in donor reviews and external evaluations as required.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Program documentation is current, complete, and audit\-ready at all times.
* Data collection systems are consistently used by field teams with high accuracy and minimal errors.
* Donor reports are submitted on time with clear evidence of impact and no discrepancies flagged.
* Leadership has timely, reliable data to make informed decisions about program strategy and resource allocation.
* A culture of data\-driven reflection is embedded within program teams.


**What’s Hard About This Role**
* Building data collection habits in field teams with varying levels of digital literacy and capacity.
* Translating complex data into simple, compelling narratives for diverse audiences — from community workers to government partners to international donors.
* Travelling across rural and urban locations in India to support field teams and ensure data quality at source.
* Keeping pace with evolving M\&E frameworks, donor reporting standards, and technology tools in a fast\-growing organisation.


**WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS**
* You will be the evidence backbone of programs that directly impact millions of children and adults with disabilities across four states.
* Your data systems and insights will determine how Sol’s ARC grows, adapts, and advocates for systemic change.
* You will build deep expertise in program M\&E, data management, and development sector reporting.
* You will grow within an organisation that values transparency, equity, and bold social impact.


**Who We’re Looking For**

* Preferred / Added Advantage – Proficiency in data analysis tools such as Excel or Looker; experience with digital MIS or data management platforms.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
**Technical Project Manager** 




  





**Location:** 
 Mumbai (Head Office) \| Work from the office
 



  





**Experience:** 
 5 to 8 years
 



  





**Gynoveda** 
 is India's first Ayurveda fertility healthcare company. 50\+ clinics across India. 100\+ doctors—20,000\+ babies born through our treatment. We treat period health, PCOS, and infertility at the root cause, and we are expanding.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




  





 The architecture is decided. The agency builds. You make sure what they build is right.
 



  





 You convert the blueprint into agency deliverables. You review the code and design that comes back. You catch what is wrong before it goes live. You run delivery sprint by sprint. You manage a team of two, a DevOps Engineer and a Website Specialist, and you work directly with the founders.
 



  





 This role needs range, not one deep specialty. ERP, integrations, databases, cloud infrastructure, websites. You have worked hands\-on across most of these earlier in your career. Now you can review and question all of them without building any—one person, holding the entire stack accountable.
 



  





 We run on off\-the\-shelf tools, configured well. Custom development is the exception. If your first instinct is to build from scratch, this role is not for you. If your first instinct is to check whether the vendor configured the existing tool correctly, apply.
 



  





**What You Will Own:** 




  




* Technical review of all agency deliverables: code, architecture, quality gates
* The integration layer connecting our systems: specification, build oversight, testing, go\-live
* Website platform evaluation, migration, and optimization
* Marketing technology integrations, validated with the marketing team
* Infrastructure decisions, executed through the DevOps Engineer
* Tool evaluation and recommendations across the stack
* Sprint tracking and delivery coordination with the agency



  





**What You Will Not Own:** 




  





 Product roadmap. ERP workflow design. BI strategy. Agency commercials. These sit with the founders and other leaders. You are the technical authority on delivery, not the strategist deciding what gets built.
 



  





**What You Must Bring:** 




  




* 5 to 8 years in technology roles, minimum 3 years managing outsourced development teams or agencies
* Vendor review experience with proof: you have found real problems in agency code or architecture and can walk us through specific examples
* ERP implementation or configuration on any major platform (ERPNext, Odoo, Zoho One, SAP Business One, NetSuite, Dynamics 365, or similar). ERP thinking matters more than the platform name.
* Database evaluation: schema design, query performance, MariaDB or Postgres familiarity
* Cloud infrastructure literacy, AWS preferred. Able to evaluate decisions even if not hands\-on daily.
* Integration patterns: APIs, webhooks, ETL, event\-based flows
* Experience where end users are non\-tech staff in physical locations: clinics, hospitals, retail, warehouses
* Configure first. Build only when configuration genuinely cannot solve it.



  





**This Role Is Not for You If:** 




  




* You manage timelines and status reports but have never personally reviewed vendor code or architecture
* You cannot recall a specific instance where you caught a vendor's technical mistake
* Your 90\-day plan centers on building a new product or app
* You have only managed in\-house engineering teams, never an agency or vendor
* You are a coder first. This role reviews and directs. It does not build.
* You have depth in one layer and no working knowledge of the rest



  





**Why Join:** 




  




* One person's technical judgment governs the entire stack. That person is you.
* Founders sit in daily operations. Decisions move in days, not quarters.
* The systems you keep honest serve real patients across 50\+ clinics.
* The network is expanding fast. The technology spine is being built now, under your watch.\|

description:

 Global Project Manager \- Johnson Baby
   

  

**What We Do**
 At Kenvue, we realize the extraordinary power of everyday care. Built on over a century of heritage and rooted in science, we’re the house of iconic brands \- including NEUTROGENA®, AVEENO®, TYLENOL®, LISTERINE®, JOHNSON’S® and BAND\-AID® that you already know and love. Science is our passion; care is our talent.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 Our global team is \~ 22,000 brilliant people with a workplace culture where every voice matters, and every contribution is appreciated. We are passionate about insights, innovation and committed to delivering the best products to our customers. With expertise and empathy, being a Kenvuer means having the power to impact millions of people every day. We put people first, care fiercely, earn trust with science and solve with courage – and have brilliant opportunities waiting for you! Join us in shaping our future–and yours. For more information, click here.

 Director, Global Johnson’s Portfolio and Project Management
   

  

**Location:**
 Asia Pacific, India, Maharashtra, Greater Mumbai
   

  

**Work Location:**
 Hybrid
   

  

**What You Will Do**
**Position Summary**
 The Manager, Portfolio Management for Kenvue’s global brand Johnson’s, is responsible for leading brand portfolio \& governance in line with Kenvue’s operating model. The role partners with global Johnson’s marketing team to develop project innovation pipelines and co\-leads the projects execution through regional project managers responsible for Johnson’s.
   

  

 This role works in close partnership with global Marketing teams, R\&D and Supply Chain teams to deliver brand growth objectives and improve E2E product supply performance through an integrated approach across the functions. The role enables the development of product life cycle strategies that are customer centric, compliant to regulatory/safety requirements and optimize supply chain performance.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Primary responsibilities of the role include:
   

  

* Deliver assigned projects as part of portfolio management to achieve the business growth strategy objectives and delivers inter\-regional and intra\-regional franchise growth targets identified in the operating model
* Has full end\-to\-end accountability for the flawless transfer of new products and processes from R\&D or other transferring partners into the Supply Chain
* Serve as a functionally agnostic liaison to the business and the cross\-functional team to co\-create an aligned inter\-regional and intra\-regional to deliver all project’s KPIs ie budget, timeline, demand assumptions, and other stage\-gate checklist
* Has responsibility for end\-to\-end cost and inventory optimization for assigned products, across the product life cycle
* Responsible for project data integrity in the portfolio management system in collaboration with the project management teams and franchise/region function leads; ensure data standards are achieved with continuous improvement.
* Facilitates global Johnson’s project portfolio decision making that best supports brand need state \& balances existing portfolio


**Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree required. MBA or MS is preferred. A degree in engineering, supply chain, or relevant field is a plus.
* A minimum of 8\+ \-12 years of diverse experience across different areas of the Supply Chain is required, including direct experience with Project and Portfolio Mgmt.
* PMP certification and /or other industry and project management certification a plus.
* Experience in a Consumer, packaged goods or regulated industry is preferred. Knowledge of the consumer healthcare industry.
* Proven success with portfolio management at franchise / business unit level preferred, with demonstrated success in managing large, global, complex, interrelated programs / projects.
* Strong business and financial acumen with demonstrated analytical skills including understanding of financial principles and how to leverage this knowledge to make sound business decisions and/or recommendations to achieve business goals in a complex environment with multiple layers of stakeholders.
* Demonstrated experience in managing ambiguity and white space required. Strong technical knowledge with demonstrated ability to think strategically and deliver results is necessary.
* Demonstrated understanding/ability to consolidate, optimize and prioritize a portfolio of programs under constraints in a dynamic manner, specifically allocating and re\-allocating resources (budgets, FTEs) across programs is required.
* Excellent interpersonal skills, ability to act as a change agent and adapt to changing business and organizational dynamics. Strong partner and influencer to support broader E2E goals.

title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Amazon Financials Foundation Services (AFFS)
description:
**Description**
 Join Amazon Financials Foundation Services and lead transformative projects that power hundreds of billions of dollars in transactions across multiple currencies and countries. As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you'll collaborate with product, engineering, accounting, and finance teams to build scalable financial systems that fuel Amazon's global growth while shaping the future of financial accounting at Amazon scale.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Lead cross\-functional program execution by coordinating with product, engineering, accounting, and finance stakeholders to deliver financial systems that meet technical requirements and business objectives
* Drive metrics\-based decision making by collecting, analyzing, and communicating data that informs project direction and helps teams prioritize work
* Facilitate stakeholder alignment by conducting regular communication with leadership at director and VP levels, ensuring transparency around project status, risks, and key performance indicators
* Balance competing priorities by managing the tension between long\-term product vision and immediate business needs, advocating for an incremental approach that delivers value consistently
* Articulate technical strategy by translating complex technology choices and architectural decisions for diverse audiences, building shared understanding across technical and non\-technical stakeholders


 A day in the life
   

  

 In this role, you'll navigate the complexity of large\-scale financial systems integration. Your day might include facilitating alignment meetings with engineering and product teams on system architecture decisions, reviewing metrics and data to inform project direction, or presenting technical trade\-offs to senior leadership. You'll work across dozens of stakeholders to ensure teams are delivering high\-quality solutions while balancing immediate business needs with long\-term product vision. You'll find yourself translating between technical and business contexts, helping diverse groups understand the implications of technology choices, and keeping teams synchronized around shared goals and key performance indicators.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We are a collaborative group focused on advancing one of the world's most scalable, reliable, and secure e\-commerce ecosystems. Our team sits at the center of Amazon's key initiatives, working closely with product, engineering, accounting, and finance partners to continuously raise the bar on how quickly business teams can integrate with our financial systems. We're committed to building best\-in\-class finance engineering solutions through rapid iteration and data\-driven decision\-making. When you join us, you'll be part of a mission to support Amazon's businesses worldwide by creating systems that are both technically sound and operationally excellent.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 7\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 3\+ years of software development experience
* 5\+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi\-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
